verses.text: Ix paxta Jesús t'a jun lugar b'aj ayek' chi', ix k'ochxi t'a schonhab'. Ix k'och pax heb' sk'ayb'um yet'ok.

Haxo t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip ix syamoch sk'ayb'an heb' anima t'a yol spatil kulto. Tzijtum heb' ix ab'an sloloni. Palta tonhej ix sat sk'ool heb' yuj. Ix laj yalan heb': --¿B'ajtil ix sk'ayb'ej juntzanh tik jun winh tik? ¿B'aj ix yik' jun sjelanil winh tik? ¿Tas syutej winh sb'oan juntzanh milagro tik?

Yujto a jun winh tik, nhikum te' winh, yune' winh ix María. Yuk'tak sb'a winh yet' winhaj Jacobo, winhaj José, winhaj Judas yet' winhaj Simón. Ay pax heb' ix yanab' winh ayek' t'a ko kal tik, xchi heb'. Yuj chi', tonhej ix somchaj spensar heb' yuj Jesús chi'.

Palta ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha heb' schekab' Dios, ay wal yelk'och heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil. Palta haxo t'a yichanh heb' yetchonhab' heb', t'a yichanh heb' sk'ab' yok heb' yet' t'a yichanh heb' junnhej yaj yet' heb' t'a yol spat, malaj yelk'och heb', xchi Jesús.
Maj yal-laj sb'oan juntzanh milagro ta'. Tonhej ix yak'b'at sk'ab' t'a yib'anh jaywanh heb' penaay, yik sb'oxi sk'ool heb'.
Ix sat sk'ool Jesús yujto maj yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'ool. Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' sk'ayb'ej heb' ay t'a juntzanh aldea t'a slak'anil schonhab'.
Haxo Jesús ix awtankot heb' sk'ayb'um slajchawanhil. Ixlajwi chi', chatakwanhil ix yutej schekanb'at heb'. Ix ak'ji yopisio heb' yik'anel heb' enemigo.
Ayik mantzak b'at heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ayik tzex b'ati, manh eyik' jab'ok tas yik yol he b'e. Manh eyik' he pa, manh eyik' eyooch, manh eyik' he tumin. Anhej he k'okoch tzeyik'a'.
Anhej he pichul ayoch eyuuj yet' he xanhab'.
Yalnhej mach junok pat b'aj tzex k'ochi, hata' tzex aji masanto tzex paxta.
Tato ay heb' max ex chaani, tato malaj snib'ej heb' schaan yab'i, manh ex aj ta'. Tze tzikkanel spokokal eyok, yik tze ch'oxeli to manhxa eyalan heyik t'a heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Haxo ix b'at heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix laj yalanel heb' to yowalil sna sb'a heb' anima yuj smul.
Manh jantakok heb' enemigo ix yik'el heb' t'a heb' anima. Tzijtum wal heb' penaay b'aj ix laj sukek' akeite heb'. Ix laj b'oxikan sk'ool heb'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey Herodes juntzanh tastak ix sk'ulej Jesús, yujto ix te pukaxel yab'ixal t'a skal masanil heb' anima. Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ha jun winh chi', haton winhaj Juan winh ak'annak bautizar, ix pitzwixi winh t'a skal heb' chamnak. Yuj chi', ay spoder winh sk'ulan juntzanh chi', xchi winh.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' anima ix halani: --Ha jun winh chi', haton winhaj Elías, xchi heb'. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' ix halani: Haton jun schekab' Dios, icha heb' ay t'a peka', xchi heb'.

Palta haxo winhaj rey Herodes chi', ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun winh syal heb' chi', haton winhaj Juan. Haton winh ix wik'el sjolom. Ha winh ix pitzwixi t'a skal heb' chamnak, xchi winh.

Icha tik ix aj scham winhaj Juan yuj winhaj Herodes. Ay jun yuk'tak winhaj Herodes chi' skuchan Felipe, Herodías sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh. Haxo winhaj Herodes chi' ix montanel ix yetb'eyum winhaj Felipe chi'. Haxo winhaj Juan chi' ix b'at halan t'a winhaj Herodes chi': --Manh sleyalok tzik' ix yetb'eyum winh uk'tak tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi', ix te kot yowal ix Herodías chi'. Ix yak'an sk'ool winhaj Herodes chi' ix. Yuj chi', ix yal winh to syamchaj winhaj Juan chi'. Ix yak'anoch winh winh t'a preso. Ix och k'een kadena t'a winh. Haxo ix Herodías chi', ix te chichonoch sk'ool ix t'a winhaj Juan chi'. Snib'ej ix smiljicham winh, palta max yal-laj yuj ix t'a elanhchamel,

yujto toxon yojtak winhaj Herodes chi' to tojol spensar winhaj Juan chi', to yik Dios yaj winh. Yuj chi', ix xiw winh yuj winhaj Juan chi', ix yak'anoch stanhwumal winh winh, yik max cham winh yuj ix Herodías chi'. Ay b'aj syal slolonel Dios winhaj Juan t'a winhaj Herodes chi'. Tonhej ste somchaj sk'ool winh yuj winh, palta ste tzalaj winh yab'an t'a winh.

Palta ayik ix och jun q'uinh yik yab'ilal winhaj Herodes chi', hata' ix yil ix Herodías chi' tas ol yutok ix yak'ancham winhaj Juan chi', yujto ay jun niwan wael ix och yuj winh rey chi'. Ix yak' wa heb' yetyajalil winh, heb' yajal heb' soldado yet' heb' niwak winak t'a yol yik Galilea chi'.

Haxo jun ix yune' ix Herodías chi' ix k'och b'aj wan swa heb' chi'. Ix chanhalwi ix. Haxo winhaj Herodes yet' heb' winh ayoch wael yet'ok, te wach' schanhalwi ix ix yil heb'. Yuj chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --k'an t'ayin tas tza nib'ej, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix yak'an sti' winh t'a ix, ix slokan sb'i Dios winh: --Yalnhej tas junok tza k'an t'ayin, ol wak'nhej t'ayach. Wach'chom a masanil tas ay t'a yol in makb'en, nanhal ol wak' t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix.
Haxo ix elixta ix. Ix yalan ix t'a ix snun: --¿Tas a gana ol in k'ana'? xchi ix. Ix tak'wi ix snun ix chi': --Ha sjolom winhaj Juan, winh tz'ak'an bautizar tza k'ana', xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ochxi ix t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan ix: --In gana tzak' sjolom winhaj Juan, winh tz'ak'an bautizar t'ayin. T'a yol junok pultu in gana tzak' t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ix te kusk'e winh rey chi' ayik ix yab'an winh. Palta majxo yal-laj stenanek' winh, yujto toxo ix slok sb'i Dios winh. Ix yab'pax heb' winh ayek' yet' winh.
Yuj chi', ix schekb'at jun winh soldado winh stzepel sjolom winhaj Juan chi', syik'ankoti.

Ix b'at jun winh soldado chi' t'a te' preso, ix b'at yik'anel sjolom winhaj Juan chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot winh t'a yol jun pultu, ix yak'an winh t'a ix. Haxo ix ix ak'an t'a ix snun chi'.
Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi', ayik ix yab'an heb', ix k'och heb'. Ix yik'anb'at sniwanil winh heb', ix b'at smukanem heb'.
Ha heb' schekab' Jesús ix k'ochxi heb' t'ay. Ix yalan heb' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej heb' yet' masanil tas ix sk'ayb'ej heb'.

Ixto lajwi yalan heb', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Koyek ko ch'okoj b'aj malaj anima, yik skik' kip ta', xchi. Ix yal icha chi', yujto malaj skolanil heb' yuj heb' anima, yujto sk'ochnhej heb' anima t'ay. Max och jab'ok skolanil heb' swa yuj heb'.
Haxo Jesús, ix och t'a yol jun te' barko yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Sch'okoj heb' ix b'at b'aj malaj anima.
Palta tzijtum mach ix ilan sb'at heb', yojtakxo heb' to a Jesús. Yuj chi', ay heb' ix kot t'a junjun chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'. Ix b'at heb' t'a yok, ix b'ab'laj k'och heb' b'aj ix k'och chi'.

Haxo ix elta Jesús t'a yol te' barko chi', ix yilanb'ati to manh jantakok anima ayxo ek' ta'. Ix ok' sk'ool t'a heb', yujto lajan heb' icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal. Yuj chi', tzijtum tas b'aj ix sk'ayb'ej heb'.
Haxo yik wanxo sb'at k'u ix k'och heb' sk'ayb'um t'a stz'ey. Ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Ina wanxo sb'at k'u. Palta a jun lugar tik, te tzinan.
Yuj chi' tekan wach' tza chekb'at heb' anima tik b'ajtak ay anima yet' t'a juntzanh aldea t'a lak'an tik, yik wach' ol laj sman wa sb'a heb' ta', yujto malaj tas swa heb' t'a tik, xchi heb'.
--Hak'ek wa heb' a ex tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'. Palta ix yalan heb' t'ay: --¿Tom syal ko b'at ko man chab'ok am kiento denario pan, yik ol kak' swa heb'? xchi heb'.
--¿Jaye' ixim pan chi' eyet' jun? Sayek heyila', xchi Jesús t'a heb'. Haxo yik ix lajwi yilan heb', ix yalan heb' t'ay: --Anhej oye' ixim ket'nak yet' cha pitanh nok' chay, xchi heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jesús, to tz'em k'ojan heb' anima smasanil t'a jun ak'lik chi', makkiltak tz'aj heb'.
Ha ix aj em k'ojan heb' winh, ay 100 t'a junjun makan yet' 50 t'a juntzanhxo.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anchaanh oye' pan chi' Jesús yet' cha pitanh chay chi'. Ix k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh, ix yak'an yuj diosal, ix xepanb'at ixim pan chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi', yik spukanb'at heb' t'a heb' anima chi'. Ix spukanpaxb'at cha pitanh chay chi' t'a heb' smasanil.
Ix wa heb' smasanil, ix b'ut'ji heb'.
Ayik ix lajwi swa heb' chi', ix sik'ank'e lajchawexo xuuk ixim ix yak' sobre heb' yet' pax nok' chay chi'.
Oye' mil heb' winh winak ix wa'i.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um to tz'ochxi heb' t'a yol te' barko, yik sb'ab'laj k'axpajkanek' heb' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' nhajab' chi', yik sk'och heb' t'a chonhab' Betsaida. Haxo Jesús chi' ixto kani, ix yalan kilkob'a t'a heb' anima chi'.
Ixlajwi stak'lankan sb'a yet' heb', ix b'at t'a jun tzalan yik slesalwi ta'.
Haxo yik toxo ix k'ik'b'i, wanxo sk'och heb' sk'ayb'um chi' yet' te' barko t'a snanhal ha'. Haxo Jesús ix kan sch'okoj t'a sti' ha'.
Haxo yik ayto sk'ana' ix yilanb'at Jesús to wan yel yip heb' smak'an ha', yujto te ow sja ik' t'a yichanh heb'. Wan sb'eyb'at t'a yok t'a sat ha' ix k'och t'a heb'. B'enhej ijan ix ek'b'at t'a heb'.
Palta ix yilb'at heb' to wan sb'ey t'a sat ha', a snaan heb' to lab' jun wan sk'och chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix te el yaw heb'.
Ix yil heb' smasanil, yuj chi' ix te xiwk'e heb'. Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Tek'b'ejek he b'a. Ha in. Manh ex xiwok, xchi t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och t'a yol te' barko chi' yet' heb'. Ix och waan jun ik' chi' yuj. Yuj chi', ix te sat sk'ool heb'.
Wach'chom toxo ix yil jun milagro ix sb'o Jesús heb' yet' ixim pan, palta max nachajel spoder yuj heb', yujto manto yak'och jab'ok spensar heb' t'ay.
Ixlajwi sk'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' chi', ix k'och heb' t'a jun lugar skuchan Genesaret. Ix yak'ankanoch etzan te' barko chi' heb' t'a sti' ha'.
Ix lajwinhej yelta heb' t'a yol te' barko chi', ix yilanoch heb' anima to a Jesús.
Yuj chi', ix laj yalan heb' t'a smasanil jun lugar chi'. Ix laj syamanoch heb' sb'akhankot heb' penaay t'a sat swaynub' b'aj ayek' Jesús chi'.

Masanil b'ajtak ix ek' Jesús, t'a aldea, t'a chonhab' yet' b'ajtak ay anima, ix laj ik'jielta heb' penaay t'a yoltak kalle. Ix sk'anan pawor heb' t'a Jesús chi', yik syamji jab'ok sti' spichul yuj heb' penaay chi'. Haxo jantaknhej heb' ix yaman sti' spichul chi', ix b'oxikan sk'ool heb' yuj.
